description: The on-disk part layout, derived independently by the api (hippius_s3/cache/fs_store.py) and the drain agent (crates/hippius-drain-core PartKey::relative_dir + chunk_file_name). Both sides assert against this file, so a change on either side that the other does not follow fails a test instead of silently decoupling them. The layout is load-bearing beyond mere path agreement: publish_part's flock and the drain's remove_part_dir_exclusive only exclude each other because both open the SAME part directory, and a staged chunk stays invisible to the drain's completeness gate only because its name is not exactly chunk_<u32>.bin.
